_about: Routes, navigation, state, operations and components. status: built | partial | planned. Keep in sync with the code. Why → decisions.md; look → design.md; overview → README.md

/.does: the router: not signed in → /sign-in; signed in, not onboarded → /onboarding; else → /cases

/sign-in.in: root Stack, only while signed out
/sign-in.status: partial (boilerplate: email + password, sign in / make an account, Continue with Google, Check your email)

/onboarding.in: root Stack, only while signed in and not onboarded
/onboarding.status: built (first pass; words and look to be refined)

/settings.in: root Stack (slides over tabs, no tab bar); only while signed in and onboarded, like (tabs)
/settings.status: partial (Appearance, Walkthrough: show it again, Account: email + Sign out)

app/_layout.tsx.guards: Stack.Protected: a screen whose guard is false is taken out of the stack; whoever was on it lands on index

renders: TopBar (one, shared; shows the current tab's title)
pager: horizontal paging ScrollView holding CasesScreen, EntitiesScreen, OutcomesScreen (no TabSlot)
EntityTypesMenu (only on the entities tab, drawn last)
TabList (bottom menu) + the accent marker above the current tab's icon (slides with the pager's scrollX)

navigation.Bottom menu buttons: TabTrigger href (/cases, /entities, /outcomes); (tabs)/_layout sees the route change and slides the pager to that tab
navigation.Swipe left / right on a tab screen: the pager follows the finger; past halfway, (tabs)/_layout shows that tab's bars and calls router.navigate(its href). Order: cases, entities, outcomes. Off while a card is being dragged (TabPagerContext.swipeLocked)
navigation.Entities floating row plus (top right) →: one-type group: editor = { entityEditType: 'add', type }; Housing: addMenuOpen (AddOptionsMenu) → pick → editor; the new entity starts named after its type, in defaultCaseId
navigation.Edit card → Cancel / X / tap outside / A: editor = null (only Add / Save save first)
navigation.EntityCard / CaseCard → Delete: local state deleting → ConfirmDialog → delete on confirm
navigation.TopBar title: set by (tabs)/_layout from the tab that's showing
navigation.Entities left edge → type menu: the menu's own tab: pull it / swipe from the left edge (drags the real panel) or tap it → EntityMenuContext.menuOpen
navigation.Type menu → close: swipe left, tap the tab or the dimmed area, Android back
navigation.Outcomes chart → drag: OutcomeChart PanResponder → onSelectMonth(month) → OutcomesView pickedMonth; TabPagerContext.setSwipeLocked while the finger is down
navigation.Outcomes floating bar → outcomes dropdow: local state dropdownOpen = true (OutcomesDropdown, a floating list under the bar)
navigation.Outcomes dropdown → pick / tap outside: pick: local state outcomeKey = key, list closes; tap outside: list closes
navigation.CaseCard → tap: cases screen local state expandedId (that case's id, or null if it was already open) → ReorderableGrid expanded panel with CaseEntitiesPanel
navigation.Cases floating row bar → starting age: local state editingAge = true (EditStartingAgeCard popup); Cancel / X / tap outside / Save → false (only Save saves first)
navigation.Edit card → \"i\" beside a box's label: Field local state guideOpen = true (CostGuidePopup over the edit popup); X / tap outside → false
navigation.Sign in / Make account: useAuth().signIn / signUp → userId set → the sign-in screen's guard turns false → index → /onboarding or /cases (no navigate call)
navigation.Settings → Sign out: syncNow(), then useAuth().signOut() → userId null → (tabs) and settings are taken away → index → /sign-in. Needs a connection; a failure shows under the button
navigation.Sign in → Continue with Google: useAuth().signInWithGoogle(): Google's page opens over the app (expo-web-browser) and returns with the login → userId set → as above
navigation.Sign in → Make account (email must be co: local state linkSentTo = the email → the 'Check your email' message replaces the form; Back to sign in → null
navigation.Onboarding → each step: local state step (addCase → saveCase → swipeToEntities → addIncome → fillIncome → swipeToOutcomes → openOutcomes → pickOutcome → dragChart → done); only that step's control works
navigation.Onboarding → Skip (any step) / Start usi: useAppData().completeOnboarding() → onboarded true → the onboarding screen's guard turns false → index → /cases
navigation.Onboarding → close a popup without savin: back one step (saveCase → addCase, fillIncome → addIncome, pickOutcome → openOutcomes)
navigation.Settings → Walkthrough → Show it again: useAppData().restartOnboarding() → onboarded false → (tabs) and settings are taken away → index → /onboarding
navigation.Onboarding → income popup → Next: local state stop moves to the next box; the popup scrolls itself there

Case.caseIndex: number, display order (new = max + 1; gaps OK)

data.entity order: entities array order (also sets investment accounts 4–12)
data.OutcomeKey: netWorth | expensesPerMonth | liquidCash | liquidCashPlusInvestments | incomePerMonth | incomePlusGainsPerMonth | incomePlusAllGainsPerMonth (types.ts; labels in TypesAndVariables/outcomeLabels.ts)

ProjectionsData.what: everything saved for one user, as one object (types.ts)
ProjectionsData.editedAt: ms; when last changed on a device

LocalSlot.what: what the phone keeps for one user
LocalSlot.uploadWaiting: boolean: the phone has changes the server doesn't
LocalSlot.syncedVersion: number | null: the server row's version when the two last matched

AppDataContext.hook: useAppData() (throws when nobody is signed in); useOnboarded() (false when nobody is signed in; for routing)
holds: slot: LocalSlot for the signed-in user (keyed by userId, so a new user starts clean)
from it: onboarded, startingAge: Age, cases: Case[], entities: Entity[], recentCaseIds (private; most recently used first)
AppDataContext.storage: phone: AsyncStorage key 'projections:<userId>' (one LocalSlot per user), saved on every change. Server: Supabase table app_data, one row per user per app, uploaded 2 s after the last change, on app background / foreground, and before sign out
AppDataContext.gives: defaultCaseId: the case a new entity starts in (most recent that still exists, else the top case, else null)
AppDataContext.screens it draws itself: a spinner while loading; 'Connect to load your data' + Try again when it's this user's first time on the phone and the server can't be reached

TabPagerContext.use: ReorderableGrid (during a drag) and OutcomeChart (finger on the chart) call setSwipeLocked; (tabs)/_layout reads it

ThemeContext.hook: useTheme() → { mode, scheme, setMode, colors, lift, caseBorderWidth }
ThemeContext.storage: AsyncStorage key 'themeMode'; loaded on app start, saved on change; default system

cases screen (local).expandedId: null | caseId: the one case whose entities show under its card

outcomes screen (local).projection: null | { startingAge, cases, entities, computedCases }: the engine's results and the data they came from
outcomes screen (local).upToDate: projection's data are the same objects as useAppData()'s; false → spinner, and the engine runs once the tab is showing (usePathname() === '/outcomes')
outcomes screen (local).OutcomesView: child shown when up to date: shown = one { caseId, caseName, caseColor, series } per case that computed (padded to the longest case); pickedMonth = the chart's selected month (null = the last month); cards for failed cases
outcomes screen (local).outcomeKey: OutcomeKey (default netWorth; resets on app start)

EntityMenuContext.holds: groupKey (default income, the top of the menu), menuOpen; not saved
EntityMenuContext.use: (tabs)/_layout draws EntityTypesMenu from it; the entities screen reads groupKey and opens the menu

AuthContext.hook: useAuth() → { userId, email, signIn, signUp, signInWithGoogle, signOut }
AuthContext.holds: the signed-in user (from supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange); null = signed out
AuthContext.storage: Supabase keeps the login in AsyncStorage, so it's known offline

onboarding screen (local).page: 0 | 1 | 2: which of the three pictures is showing
onboarding screen (local).pickedMonth: in OutcomesPicture: the chart's selected month (null = the last)
onboarding screen (local).area: the size of the layer the callouts are placed on
onboarding screen (local).stop: in NewIncomePopup: salary | startAge | endAge | add

saveEntity(entity).does: add, or replace same entityId in place; its case becomes the most recent

toggleEntityHidden(entityId).does: flip isHidden; throws if not found

reorderEntities(entityIds).trigger: EntityCard grip drag → ReorderableGrid onReorder; the listed entities swap among the places they already hold in the entities array

setStartingAge(age).where: AppDataContext (Age {years, months}; 20 yrs 0 mos until set)
setStartingAge(age).trigger: Cases floating starting age bar → EditStartingAgeCard → Save

run projections for outcomes.does: masterEngine only while the Outcomes tab is showing and the data has changed since the last run (never stored); spinner meanwhile; then outcomeSeries per case

isHidden effect on projections.does: masterEngine: hidden case = left out completely (no computed case); hidden entity = skipped as if it didn't exist

saveCase(case).does: add, or replace same caseId; it becomes the most recent case

deleteCase(caseId).does: remove case AND its entities, and take it off the recent list, in one change; throws if not found

toggleCaseHidden(caseId).does: flip isHidden; throws if not found

reorderCases(caseIds).trigger: CaseCard grip drag → ReorderableGrid onReorder; rewrites caseIndex to each case's place in the list

outcomeSeries(history, key, months?).returns: Float64Array, series[month]; months pads past the end of the history (balances hold, per-month = 0)
outcomeSeries(history, key, months?).rules: OUTCOME_RULES: accounts to add up + credit (flip sign) + perMonth (this month − last month)

completeOnboarding().trigger: Onboarding → Skip, or Start using the app
completeOnboarding().does: onboarded = true (saved with the user's data)

syncNow().trigger: Settings → Sign out; the app going to the background or coming back
syncNow().does: uploads what's waiting / takes a newer copy from the server, now; resolves when it has tried

fetchRow(userId) / uploadRow(userId, dat.returns: the row | null | 'unreachable'; the new version | 'rejected' (another device saved first) | 'unreachable'

signIn / signUp / signInWithGoogle / sig.returns: what went wrong in words, or null (signUp also says when the email must be confirmed first)

restartOnboarding().does: onboarded = false; the user's data is left as it is

exampleCases().returns: { cases, entities }: 'Example life case 1' and 'Example life case 2' with fresh ids

TopBar.does: surface bar rendered once by (tabs)/_layout: Collegiate logo (left), centered title, settings button (right)

TabButton.notes: ignores TabTrigger's default row style; icon only (label is for screen readers)
exports: bottomMenuSpace(insetBottom): bottom padding every tab screen's scrolling content needs

EntityCard.layout: square; name up to 2 lines; type; 'Case:' + color dot + case name; up to 2 facts; bottom 1/4: trash, hide, edit (left 3/4) + grip (right)

entitySummary.does: entitySummary(type, inputs) → up to 2 short lines of an entity's main values for its card; unreadable inputs are left out, never thrown

EntityTypesMenu.does: SideMenu with the entity groups (22; Housing = renting + buyingHome) and their counts: plans and spending first (Income on top), a line, then the existing types

SideMenu.does: the floating rounded panel that slides in from the left, with its pull tab, edge swipe and dim; a line between sections

OutcomesDropdown.does: floating list under the Outcomes floating bar (as wide as the bar) with the seven outcomes; the one showing is tinted and checked; tap outside to close

OutcomeChart.does: Skia canvas: a line per case by month, grid, a draggable vertical selector with a dot on each line; dollar and age labels are Text around the canvas

EditEntityCard (frame).does: centered rounded popup on a PopupLayer (80% wide, max 60% tall, body scrolls): name, case dropdown, type inputs, Cancel + Add / Save

exports: Field (guide? = an "i" button beside the label that opens CostGuidePopup)
NumberField (kind: dollars | percent | signedPercent | years | months | whole | decimal | positive | number; checks its own text; guide? passes to Field)

edit cards per type.forms: components/(editEntityCards)/entityForms.ts: one form per type (read saved inputs → text; toInputs text → engine inputs | null)

CaseCard.layout: full width; case-color border (caseBorderWidth); name, color, trash/hide/edit; grip on right (lift 3%)

CaseEntitiesPanel.does: the box that comes out from under an open case card: each of the case's entities with its name, type and entitySummary facts

EditCaseCard.layout: centered landscape popup on a PopupLayer: 'New case' / 'Edit case', name + color dropdown side by side, Cancel + Save

cardControls.notes: ActionWell: filled well + lift; activeColor = hidden outline/tint; opensCard = trailing chevron. GripHandle: PanResponder; hold 120ms to pick up (haptic), then onMove(dx, dy) until onPutDown.

used for: delete case (says how many entities go with it)

exports: EmptyState (icon, title, message, optional action button)
FloatingRow (an outlined bar + a green plus on its right, floating over the top of the Cases, Entities and Outcomes lists; no onAdd = no plus)

ReorderableGrid.does: scrolling grid / list (replaces FlatList on cases and entities) whose cards drag into a new order; other cards slide out of the way

AddOptionsMenu.does: floating list under the floating row's plus (top right) when the entity group has more than one type (Housing: Renting / Buying)

EditStartingAgeCard.does: centered popup on a PopupLayer: years + months, Cancel + Save (saves startingAge)

CollegiateLogo.does: the Collegiate wordmark as one Skia path (from assets/CollegiateLogo.svg), tinted with the given color

theme.does: the only place hex values live; read through useTheme() and the tailwind token classes

formParsing.does: text ↔ number helpers for the edit cards (parse*, read*, optional, parseAgeWindow, parseLoanText, ageLabel, ageInMonths, formatDollars, ERRORS); no React, re-exported by formFields

PopupLayer.does: Modal + dim + the card centered above the keyboard; slides with the keyboard (iOS); a tap on the dim closes

CostGuidePopup.does: floating card over the edit popup: a spending guide's title, intro, tables, notes and sources; opened by the "i" button beside a Field's label

exports: groceriesMonthly / diningOutMonthly / kidYearlyCosts (the maths, for the test)
costGuides.does: what people in the Southeast typically spend, worked out from sourced constants; guide data only, the engines never read it

onboarding pieces.file: app/onboarding.tsx (not shared; all in the route file)
pictures: OutcomesPicture (runs the engine once reached; the real chart)
guide: Callout (the pointed accent box + its arrow, drawn with Skia; optional Next button)
popups: NewCasePopup (its own copy of the case popup's layout, on PopupLayer)
NewIncomePopup (its own copy of the entity popup frame, on PopupLayer; one box at a time: IncomeStop)

design._about: The look and the UI rules are in design.md. This is only where the pieces live.
design.palettes: components/theme.ts (light + dark hex; the only place color values live)
design.classes: tailwind.config.js colors = rgb(var(--token)); ThemeProvider sets the vars on the root View
design.tokens: canvas, surface, bar, inset, hairline, edge, slate, charcoal, ink, muted, onDark, onAccent, danger, green, accent{DEFAULT,tint,ink}
